name: auto-agent-team
description: Coordinate native Codex subagents and show DSH-style team state, tasks, dependencies, verification, and review in a live dashboard.

interface.shortDescription: Native Codex subagent orchestration with a live team dashboard
interface.longDescription: Adds a local Agent Team MCP runtime and DSH-style dashboard for members, tasks, dependencies, progress, verification, and review. It is designed to work alongside the standalone Auto Agent Team Skill rather than installing a duplicate Skill.
defaultPrompt: Build this project with Auto Agent Team and show the team dashboard.
Split this work across native Codex subagents, verify it, and review it.
Open the Auto Agent Team dashboard for this workspace.
